Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 8 Ingredients 1 cup kiwi, peeled and chopped (about 2 kiwi) 2 Tablespoons onion, finely chopped (try red or sweet) 1 Tablespoon jalapeno pepper, minced (seeds removed) 1 Tablespoon cilantro, finely chopped 1 Tablespoon fresh lime juice 1/8 teaspoon salt Directions Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir gently to combine. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try with tacos, tostadas, fish, chicken, and more. Texture will be best when freshly made.
